header.purpose: Reviewable compactfacts for sourceowner; not published by Cloud

parser.wire_iterator: Explicit lossless field/tag/wire occurrence extraction in private script

tag_map.owner: top-level1 object -> Appearance3 flags -> AppearanceFlags40 repeatedNPCSaleData

header.identity_boundary: Appearance IDs/currency object refs are client-local namespaces; no serverID or gp binding. Duplicate NPC/name/price tuples never deduplicated.
header.direction_boundary: Raw sale_price/buy_price labels only. UI BuyFrom/SellTo mapping not asserted pending offline pixel fixtures.
header.currency_boundary: Raw prices have no assigned gp/unit. Currency_object_type_id remains clientreference; missing currencyref does not establish gp. Questlabels stored privately withhash/length receipt, never narrative text here.
header.zero_boundary: Explicit numeric0 remains0, not globalNPCabsence/free/unavailable policy. Every repeatedrawtuple retained independently.

unknown_fields.meaning: UNMAPPED/UNKNOWN_SEMANTICS; rawpayload provenance in pinnedDAT and coverageartifact, never guessed

encoding_boundary: Dictionary interning repeated strings/identical field objects only; numeric columns remain literal; no tuple/row deduplication; indices preserve every source row and order.
